text:
debrief db-021
1) the ac-tor w-r-o-t-e a r-e-l-a-b-e-l s-c-h-e-m-e and p-r-o-c-e-s-s-e-d a f-a-k-e s-e-r-i-a-l n-u-m-b-e-r f-i-l-e while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e o-r-i-g-i-n-a-l a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k
2) the ac-tor c-r-e-a-t-e-d t-a-b-l-e-s o-f f-a-l-s-e c-o-l-d c-h-a-i-n r-e-c-o-r-d-s and l-o-g-g-e-d t-h-e m-e-d-i-c-i-n-e as c-u-r-r-e-n-t-l-y c-o-o-l-e-d while i-g-n-o-r-i-n-g t-h-e t-e-m-p-e-r-a-t-u-r-e m-o-n-i-t-o-r a-l-e-r-t s-y-s-t-e-m
3) the ac-tor u-s-e-d p-h-a-r-m-a-c-y d-i-s-t-r-i-b-u-t-i-o-n c-h-a-n-n-e-l-s and p-r-e-p-a-r-e-d s-h-i-p-p-i-n-g m-a-n-i-f-e-s-t-s for d-e-l-i-v-e-r-y while b-y-p-a-s-s-i-n-g t-h-e r-e-g-u-l-a-t-o-r-y a-p-p-r-o-v-a-l s-t-a-g-e
4) the ac-tor h-i-d-d-e n-a-t-u-r-a-l c-h-o-l-d c-h-a-i-n v-i-o-l-a-t-i-o-n d-a-t-a and m-o-d-i-f-i-e-d b-a-t-c-h l-o-g-s to a-p-p-e-a-r c-o-m-p-l-i-a-n-t while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g i-n-t-e-r-n-a-l q-u-a-l-i-t-y c-o-n-t-r-o-l v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n
5) the ac-tor d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-e-d the p-l-a-n as c-a-s-e e-x-h-i-b-i-t 021 and s-t-o-r-e-d the p-r-o-s-e-c-u-t-i-o-n o-u-t-l-i-n-e in f-i-l-e-s while i-g-n-o-r-i-n-g t-h-e e-t-h-i-c-a-l r-e-v-i-e-w r-e-q-u-i-r-e-m-e-n-t
